summary.en-US: Adds a Chaos Value column (quantity × price, in chaos) to the stash table on wealthyexile.com. Divine prices are converted using a rate worked out from the page. Click a value to copy it.

description.en-US:
Wealthy Exile shows each stash item's Quantity, Price and Total, but the Total is often in divines. This add-on adds a Chaos Value column next to Total that shows the same value in chaos, so you can compare items at a glance. Features
  • Chaos Value = Quantity × Price, shown in chaos (for example 780c or 1,234c).
  • Prices in divines are converted using a divine rate worked out from your own stash page. You can also set your own rate.
  • Hover a value to see the working, for example "65 × 12c = 780c".
  • Click a value to copy the number to your clipboard.
  • Keeps up with the site as you sort, filter, search, scroll, switch tabs and re-sync.
  • An address bar button, shown only on Wealthy Exile, to turn the column on or off and set a manual divine rate.
Privacy The add-on collects no data and makes no network requests. It only runs on wealthyexile.com and cannot read or change any other website. This is an unofficial add-on. It is not affiliated with Wealthy Exile or Grinding Gear Games. Source code: https://github.com/viexhd/wealthy-exile-chaos-value

version.approval_notes:
The code is plain, unminified JavaScript with no build step, so no separate source upload is needed. Source: https://github.com/viexhd/wealthy-exile-chaos-value

The stash page on wealthyexile.com needs a Path of Exile account to sign in. To test without an account, clone the repository and open test/fixture.html in Firefox: it loads a saved copy of the real stash table and the same content script (src/parse.js and src/content.js), with buttons that mimic the site's sorting, row reuse and navigation.

Permissions: only "storage" (on/off setting, manual rate and last detected rate) and host access to *://*.wealthyexile.com/*. No network requests, no remote code. Clicking a Chaos Value cell copies that number using navigator.clipboard.writeText from the click handler.
